0.0: That reminds me, there was no data on #b#p2300000##k in the documents we found. I hope she's not upset. I should speak with her.

yes.0: I should talk to #bRoo-D#k in the lab.

1.0: D-o my legs look shorter? That stupid storage bag... Sigh... Oh, hey, #b#h0##k. What's up?\r\n#L0##b#p2300000#, we didn't find anything on you in the lab. Are you okay?#l\n#k
1.1: Me? I don't care who I am. \r\n#L0##bReally? You don't want to know who you really are? Who you used to be?#l\n#k
1.2: I'd be lying if I said I had no interest, but I like my life. I get to spend my time with people I really like and research all the neat stuff I could ever think of! This is like heaven compared to #p2154009#'s lab.\r\n#L0##bStill...#l\n#k
1.3: Besides, look how cute I am! What if I was really scary looking before? Maybe you wouldn't have rescued me. \r\n#L0##bI would have rescued you.#l\n#k
1.4: Hehehe, I know, I was just teasing. Anyway, I don't care about my past as long as I'm happy in the present. It's just not important to me. But your past IS important to you, and I think you should never stop hunting until you find it.

yes.0: You're the closest thing I have to a family, #h0#. I'll be there for you, no matter what.
